source.title: Survey of Migratory Fishes in Pansipit River and Taal Lake
source.pdfReviewMethod: The six scanned pages were rendered and visually reviewed; text extraction returned no usable article text.

officialHtmlPage.pageTitle: Survey Migratory Fishes in Pansipit River and Taal Lake
officialHtmlPage.mismatchDescription: The HTML text describes catch, effort, and catch per unit effort for five Tayabas Bay fishing gears over 1983-1988. It is not the abstract for the titled Pansipit/Taal article and was excluded as evidence.

reviewedPdf.identity: The PDF cover/article pages confirm the Pansipit River and Taal Lake title, authors, journal volume, and 1990 publication year.
reviewedPdf.methods: One fish corral in Pansipit River and three separate fish corrals in Taal Lake were monitored daily for catches; two of the Taal corrals were in San Nicolas and one in Agoncillo.

pansipitTable.tableTitle: Total production (in kg) of Pansipit Fish Corral, July 1983 to June 1984
pansipitTable.samplingUnit: One fish corral; not a whole-river survey.

taalTable.tableTitle: Total production (in kg) of Taal Lake fish corrals, July 1983 to June 1984
taalTable.samplingUnit: Three fish corrals; reported separately from Pansipit River.

reviewedPdf.abstractTableDiscrepancy: The abstract includes Mugil dussumieri in the combined system name list; the Pansipit table instead reports Mugil sp. No species-level Pansipit assignment is made for the abstract-only name.
reviewedPdf.larvalSampling: The paper separately describes larval/fry sampling in Balayan Bay, 10-15 m from shore near the mouth of Pansipit River. This is retained as a Balayan Bay sampling locality, not assigned to the river or estuary.
limits: A fish-corral catch sample is not a systematic census of the river or lake.
The annual production tables are historical catch weights, not current abundance, occupancy, catchability, diet, or safety data.
Taxon spellings and rank are preserved as printed; no accepted-name crosswalk is part of this review.
No exact corral coordinates or estuary boundary are reported in the reviewed material.

decision.rights: No item-specific redistribution license was identified in the inspected PDF; do not publish copied table rows until applicable terms are reviewed.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Crosswalk each source-spelled name against an authoritative taxonomic source while preserving the 1990 spelling and rank.
Check journal/publisher reuse terms before publishing transcribed table data.
Keep single-corral catch data, whole-waterbody distribution claims, estuary locality, current presence, and larval sampling as separate evidence types.
